name: clara-care-mcp
description: The CLARA Care Model Context Protocol (MCP) server for clinical evidence retrieval, FIDES drug-drug interaction verification, and medical guidelines in Vietnam.

tools.name: check_drug_interaction
tools.description: Deterministic drug-drug interaction and dosage safety verification using FIDES engine against Vietnam National Pharmacopoeia (DAV) and DrugBank 5.1+.

drugs.description: List of active pharmaceutical ingredients or Vietnamese medication brand names

tools.name: search_medical_evidence
tools.description: Federated biomedical guideline and evidence retrieval across DAV Pharmacopoeia, WHO Guidelines, openFDA, and PubMed.

query.description: Clinical search query or guideline topic

tools.name: consult_clinical_council
tools.description: Multi-specialty clinical deliberation request covering Cardiology, Nephrology, Endocrinology, Neurology, and Clinical Pharmacology.

specialties.description: List of medical specialties to convene
